T: Fish for the colony, dancing shoes optional.
D: An emperor penguin who can't sing but can tap dance sets out to find out why the fish are disappearing.
P: Serve the fish when Mumble brings food back for the whole colony.
S: Colony crumbed sardines with lemon mayo
the fish the whole colony depends on

Butterflied sardine fillets crumbed in panko and lemon zest, fried golden and crunchy, with a lemon and herb mayo and wedges for squeezing. Pat 500g butterflied sardine fillets dry. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 100g panko mixed with the zest of 1 lemon and salt. Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. Mix 120g mayo with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill. Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.
Iceberg lettuce cut into wedges with creamy blue cheese dressing, crispy bacon and chopped tomato.
the blizzard the emperor penguins huddle through

Light choux puffs beaten with cheddar and parmesan, piped into balls and baked until hollow, then dusted snowy white with finely grated parmesan. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the pan, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated cheddar and 40g grated parmesan. Pipe 24 small balls onto lined trays. Bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden. While warm, dust heavily with 30g very finely grated parmesan.
M: the fish Mumble brings back to the colony
White fish and prawns in a parsley white sauce, topped with buttery mash and baked until golden.
the giant fishing trawlers taking the colony's fish

A thick creamy chowder of white fish, prawns, potato, corn and bacon with dill, ladled into hollowed crusty cob loaves. Fry 100g diced bacon and 1 diced onion for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml fish stock, 400ml milk and 400g diced potato. Simmer 15 minutes. Add 400g diced white fish, 200g peeled raw prawns and 200g corn kernels and simmer 4 minutes until just cooked. Stir in 100ml cream and chopped dill. Cut the tops off 4 small cob loaves, hollow them out and ladle in the chowder.
W: snow-white and pink, like the Antarctic sky
Desiccated coconut mixed with condensed milk and icing sugar, half tinted pink, pressed in layers and set.
K: Gloria, the best singer in the colony, and the pink krill penguins live on

Strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, topped with whipped cream and a shower of pink sprinkles. Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 750g vanilla ice cream and 400ml cold milk until thick and pink. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and scatter with pink sprinkles and a halved strawberry. Serve straight away with wide straws.

Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into 4 wedges. Mash 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with lemon and pepper. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with bacon and 1 diced tomato.

m.note: the fish Mumble brings back to the colony
m.how: Poach 600g white fish in 500ml milk for 5 minutes and flake. Make a sauce with 40g butter, 3 tbsp flour and the poaching milk, add 200g peeled prawns and chopped parsley, and pour into a dish with the fish. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 40g butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: snow-white and pink, like the Antarctic sky
w.how: Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk and 250g icing sugar into a stiff paste. Press half into a lined 20cm tin, tint the rest pink with a drop of colouring and press on top. Chill 2 hours until firm and cut into squares.
